d: myZoi is an exciting fintech start-up aiming to promote financial inclusion globally. Our vision is to provide a level playing field to the unbanked and the underbanked in accessing essential financial services in an affordable, convenient, and transparent fashion. We are looking for smart, ambitious, and purpose driven individuals to join us in this journey.
This is an opportunity to join myZoi as a Chief Technology Officer. The role will be based in the UAE.
q: Expert knowledge of mainstream cloud provider (AWS), Cloud-native services, and elastic infrastructure.
Expert background in .NET technology stack, distributed systems, authentication mechanisms, asynchronous event processing, message queues, and architecture patterns.
Knowledgeable on modern object orientated programming practises including entity frameworks, dynamic reflection, and reusable interfaces.
Familiarity with 3rd party system integrations via APIs (HTTP/REST), host-to-host (file exchange by FTP), with background jobs processing of real-time, event triggered, and async automations.
Familiar with OWASP, secure by design, secure coding practises, code scanning, unit testing, dependency management (deprecation, vulnerabilities, licensing)
Extensive experience with DevOps including pipeline, release management, multi AWS account deployments.
Required experience in front-end AngularJS, and good to have familiarity with modular frameworks such as ASP.NET Boilerplate, ASPNetZero, ABP.IO
Overseeing scrum teams, engineers, and ensuring reliable delivery of sprints, change management of features and bug fixes, and backlog
Experience with operating highly-available production financial systems
Familiarity with SQL databases, DNS, service discovery, and related infrastructure components
Ability to wear multiple hats such as individual contributor, team lead, solution architect, facilitator.
Beneficial is knowledge of FinTech ecosystem, inclusive of Blockchain, Digital Payments, Primer Services and Transaction Banking Enhancements, as well as other innovations in this space.
15 years’ experience in similar technology leadership role
Experience in startups & technology companies a major plus
Understanding and appreciation for the complexities of the Group’s footprint
Motivated to address the impact of innovation technology in Financial Services
Imaginative and creative approach to how we do work
Curiosity about new technologies, workflows, and products
Ability to see things from multiple perspectives, as well as ask the question “why” continuously
Tireless work ethic and enthusiasm to execute and get things done

The role holder is authorised to manage and operate within the scope of the roles and responsibilities outlined above. Role holders are not authorised beyond the scope of this job description unless they have a formal delegation of authority.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
r: Working with the CEO, CPO, Product Owners, and partners to lead technology build, evaluate technology trade-offs, oversee vendor engineering engagements, and deliver features and capabilities aligned to the business model to build on the minimum viable product (MVP) to successful global rollout.
The Chief Technology Officer will discuss with partners, fintechs, co-creation clients, and business to expand the Company’s product offering and geographical footprint.
Co-ordinate, question and interrogate technology opportunities with engineering team and innovate to sustain a competitive advantage.

Employ a managerial mindset that seeks to optimise business outcomes for the Company while establishing sound governance, internal processes, adherence to policies and standards. This role requires close coordination with the SC Ventures CTO.

Thought leadership and demonstratable subject matter expertise on use of machine learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Blockchain, APIs, cyber security, DevSecOps and similar technology applications.
Establish a sound technology operation covering incident management, problem management, service levels (SLAs) and business continuity processes
Have expertise and professional experience in software development and deep understanding of technology delivery.
Participate in assessing and hiring technical personnel and support the growth in aggressive go-to-market plans.
Familiarity with ERP and financial systems (purchase orders, invoices, receipts) is desirable.
Participate with anchor and banks / financial service providers in establishing new integrations.
Engage with relevant Standard Chartered Functions including Technology and Information and Cyber Security (ICS) for governance and key-control-indicators.
Advantageous to have experience in ITIL and ISO27001
x: Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation , one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
In line with our Fair Pay Charter , we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance , with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.
Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

d: Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,460 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.

People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.
q: Is fully conversant with the hotel services & promotions.
Ensures that guest safety is top priority.
Follow the rules and regulations of the local authorities.
Maintains high confidentiality in regards to guest privacy.
Ensures that all potential and real hazards of the car/bus or relevant equipment is reported to his / her supervisor.
Follows emergency procedures for the security and safety of guests and employees.
Works in a safe manner that does not harm or injure self or others.
Maintains the highest standards of personal hygiene, dress, uniform, appearance, body language and conduct.
Acquires and uses information from the Concierge’s updated database of regular guests and VIP guests to provide personalised service.
Welcome and escorts guests to and from the car/bus in a courteous manner.
Promotes Radisson Blu Hotels, inviting guests to return.
Maximizes customer satisfaction and utilization of hotel facilities by promoting hotel restaurants and other services to customers.
Knows how to handle “100% Guest satisfaction”.
Keeps self updated on all local events, sights, restaurants, activities etc., in order to provide customers with updated information, and assistance.
Provides guests with hotel brochures, local maps and refers them to the Concierge for further information.
Proactively informs Front Office staff regarding spelling of guest’s names based on luggage labels.
Knows the names of key people within Radisson Blu and Owner.
Uses the ABC approach to respond to negative comments and complaints; and notifies Concierge, and appropriate Department Head immediately for appropriate follows-up.
Displays a Yes I Can! attitude at all times.
Updates self on guest room availability.
Updates self on conference, banqueting and other events in the hotel.
Is fully aware of Radisson Blu service concepts.
Is fully aware of all current hotel promotions.
Communicates effectively with customers, colleagues, and supervisors.
Demonstrates teamwork by co-operating and assisting Front Office as needed.
Attends meetings and training required by the Chief concierge.
Accepts flexible work schedule necessary for uninterrupted service to hotel guests.
Maintains vehicles and ensures they are clean, tidy and in good shape; reports defects to the Front Office Manager.
Continuously seeks to endeavor professionalism in own job function.
Road rules & regulations of the local country.
Hotel fire, bomb and emergency procedures
Hotel health and safety policies and procedures
Hotel facilities and nearby places of interest and emergency numbers (i.e. hospitals, petrol stations, tourist sights)
Hotel and corporate marketing and promotional programs
Corporate clients and clients generating high business volume
Responsible Business: show involvement and be interested in environmental and/or social issues by participating in Responsible Business hotel and departmental activities.
Any other duties as assigned by the supervisors.
r: Checks the daily arrival list received from the concierge for arrival or departure guests that requests transportation.
Being the first point of contact he/she has to portray a professional image as per the standards of the Radisson Hotel Group.
Welcomes guests with a smile and wish them according to the time of the day.
Assists guests with luggage into the car or off the car.
Opens the door to all guests.
Offer guests with the choice of music in the car or reading material as provided.
Drive as per the rules and regulations of the country and stick to speed limits.

d: Goodman Masson is partnering with a new financial markets venture under formation in Oman. Backed by prominent institutional investors, the business is building its operations from the ground up and is now hiring during the build phase.
This is an opportunity to join at an early stage and help establish the secure, resilient and highly available technology infrastructure required to support critical business operations.

The Senior Infrastructure / Cloud Engineer will be responsible for designing, managing and securing the organisation’s cloud and on-premises infrastructure. This includes cloud platforms, servers, storage, networking, virtualisation and containerised environments, ensuring systems remain reliable, secure and available.

Reporting to the Head of IT Infrastructure, you will also provide technical leadership and day-to-day supervision to assigned Infrastructure Team Members, coordinating tasks, resolving complex technical issues and supporting the ongoing development of the infrastructure environment.
q: A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
At least five years’ experience in infrastructure and/or cloud engineering .
Strong hands-on experience managing cloud and on-premises infrastructure environments.
Sound knowledge of server administration, networking, firewalls, VPNs, backup, disaster recovery and high availability.
Experience with infrastructure security, patching, access controls and incident management.
Working proficiency in relevant technologies, including OCI, Azure, AWS, VMware, Hyper-V, Windows and Linux.
Familiarity with containerisation and infrastructure automation tools, including Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell and Python.
Experience supervising, mentoring or guiding technical team members.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain composed when resolving critical production incidents.
Excellent communication, documentation and prioritisation skills.
Relevant professional certifications in cloud, infrastructure or networking technologies.
Experience supporting business-critical or highly available production environments.
Experience coordinating infrastructure projects and working with external technology vendors.
r: Manage cloud infrastructure across OCI, Azure and AWS, alongside servers, storage and virtualisation platforms including VMware and Hyper-V.
Administer Windows and Linux servers, enterprise infrastructure services and containerised environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
Automate infrastructure deployment, configuration and maintenance using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell and Python.
Support networking, firewalls, VPNs and cloud connectivity to maintain secure and reliable infrastructure services.
Manage backup, disaster recovery, monitoring and high-availability solutions to support business continuity.
Implement infrastructure security measures, patching, access controls and relevant compliance requirements.
Troubleshoot and resolve incidents affecting critical production systems, escalating significant risks and incidents where appropriate.
Maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures and infrastructure diagrams.
Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of assigned Infrastructure Team Members, providing technical guidance and monitoring task completion.
Coordinate with internal IT teams, cloud providers, technology vendors and service providers on support, maintenance and project delivery.
x: Omani nationals are strongly encouraged to apply.
This is an opportunity to play a key role in building the technology foundations of a new financial markets venture, combining hands-on engineering with technical leadership as the business develops.

q: 0-2 years of experience in Flight Stimulator Engineering.
Knowledge of programming is an advantage.
If you meet the criteria and you are enthusiastic about the role, we would welcome your application. To complete the application you would need the following document(s):
Ensures that activities are performed to the required standard using laid down procedures to maintain maximum and continuous simulator service availability.
Carries out fault escalation and problem rectification in accordance with the fault handling and escalation procedures to avoid loss of revenue.
Updates and maintains flight simulator records according to business requirements.
Ensures adequate spares are maintained and faulty units are regularly dispatched for repairs.
In case of defective items, packs and send shipments for item to be repaired.
Handle product exchange with manufacturers and record all related activities.

Monitors the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and supervision of the quality of customer services, initiating the corrective actions when necessary to maintain successful operation of the flight simulator.
Carries out preventive and corrective actions with minimum impact on customer satisfaction.
Ensures that safety and security regulations are strictly adhered to in full.
Works closely with Simulator Supervisors and Duty managers to gain the required knowledge and experience.
Ensure to take care of the assigned simulators to be compliance with aviation safety all time and maintaining the certification of the devices in annual basis by completing the necessary tasks.
Work in all tasks assigned by the Simulator Duty Manager during the shift to ensure meeting the priorities of the departments.
Completing all assigned tasks requested by line manager to ensure continuity of work including internal and external projects.
Contribute to the quarterly QTG runs and associated checks.
Ensure to complete all documentation tasks related to the assigned responsibilities.
Ensures that day-to-day operations are effective and efficient to provide best services to customers.
Continuously update technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reading professional publications, and conducting research on fault diagnosis.
Develop simulator technical support skills by applying technical knowledge to perform simple or routine tasks associated with best commercial practice and guidelines.
